title: Music playback and Apple CarPlay issues
summary: This topic centers on music playback, Apple CarPlay, and radio behavior, with clear feedback ranging from praise for Apple CarPlay to complaints about playback problems and many fragments that only mention audio behavior without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the Apple CarPlay experience as a standout app feature.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe music not playing correctly with navigation or Apple Music and a rattling noise triggered at certain audio tones.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention ongoing radio or music playback, muted or missing audio, pause-control issues, and Apple CarPlay references without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a clear sentiment pattern.
